title: ctenitis equestris
intro: Ctenitis equestris, commonly known as the Knight's Shield Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known to possess various health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis equestris include its potential to exhibit analgesic and anti-ulcerogenic properties, which can aid in pain relief and stomach protection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and sesquiterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
